name: Coordinator agent (M1) — 14-case golden set with holdout (H5)
description: H5 (GRAND-NARRATIVE-PLAN.md §5-1): extends the Phase-4 8-case skeleton (eval/coordinator.evalset.json) to 14 cases so a train/dev (10) + holdout (4) split exists.
